title: Serialization (what can travel)
summary: Data crossing boundaries — remotes, DataStores, HttpService JSON — must be serializable: tables of numbers/strings/booleans/other tables. Functions, threads, and most live objects can't cross; tables are COPIED, not shared.

verification.notes: Serialization rules summarized from remote and DataStore documentation.

explanation.whatItIs: Data leaves your process in serialized form — flattened into bytes. Only certain shapes survive the trip; everything else errors or silently drops.
explanation.whyItExists: Networks and databases speak bytes, not Luau objects. Serialization is the translation layer, with strict rules.
whenToUse: Remote arguments: numbers, strings, booleans, tables, Instances (as references), datatypes like Vector3
DataStores: tables of primitives (no Instances, no NaN/inf, size caps)
JSON: same table-of-primitives shape; mixed array+dictionary keys can be lost — keep arrays arrays
whenNotToUse: Expecting shared table identity across the wire — receivers get copies
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
What crosses the wire:
  numbers, strings, booleans, nil-ish absence,
  tables (deep-copied), Instances (as refs),
  engine datatypes (Vector3, CFrame, Color3…)

What doesn't:
  functions, threads, metatables, non-serializable specials

Sender's table ≠ receiver's table. Copies. Always.
```
tips: For DataStores: keep keys consistent, version your schema, avoid NaN
Instances over remotes arrive as references — the receiver must be able to ACCESS them
Test JSON round-trips for mixed tables; prefer pure arrays or pure dictionaries per table
commonMistakes: Sending a function and getting a serialization error
Mutating a sent table on the receiver and expecting the sender to see it
Storing Instances in DataStores (store IDs/paths instead)
Huge payloads over remotes hitting size limits

examples.title: Safe save shape
examples.code:
-- ✅ DataStore-friendly:
local saveData = {
    version = 2,
    coins = 150,
    inventory = { "sword", "potion" },       -- array of strings
    settings = { music = true, volume = 0.8 }, -- dict of primitives
}

-- ❌ Not savable:
-- { pet = workspace.Pets.Fluffy }      -- an Instance
-- { fn = function() end }              -- a function
-- { weird = 0/0 }                      -- NaN
